author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I put the tools down this week! The @HomeDepot flew us out to check out all of the newest and best products coming to their stores and to help celebrate the FIFA World Cup 2026™ match in their hometown, Atlanta.

One of the best parts for me was the behind the scenes look at all of the new products and innovations coming to the store. As someone who has spent the last few decades renovating homes and teaching homeowners, it’s always exciting to see how brands continue to find ways to make projects easier, faster and more attainable to homeowners. That's right up my alley!

I had such a great time connecting with the creators in this space as well as the Home Depot team, product category merchants and brand partners in the space. There is so much innovation and improvement in the product space. This event was a reminder of how important it is to get together to learn from each other and to work together to educate and equip homeowners with the right products so they can tackle projects
title: I Put the Tools Down This Week…
